title: Free Night Awards on One Reservation: Count, Night Order and Mixed Payment
content:
Desk guidance for the Free Night Awards on how awards held by one member are combined on a Reward Night Rate reservation.

## The rule

Awards held by one member are combined on a reservation one night each.

1. **Count.** A reservation carries at most the most awards per reservation of the award type. The count is the number of awards standing applied to that reservation at the moment of handling, taken before the award being applied; the award being applied is allowed only while that count together with the award itself does not exceed the most awards per reservation. Where the award type's terms provide that a night can be paid by only one award, a night is paid by one award only.
2. **Night order.** Where the award type's terms provide that awards are always applied to the earliest nights, awards pay the earliest nights of the reservation and points pay the nights after them, so an award is applied only to the earliest night of the reservation not yet paid by an award.
3. **Other nights.** A reservation with more nights than awards pays the remaining nights with points where the award type's terms allow the award to sit on a reservation whose other nights are paid with points. Where the terms do not allow nights paid in cash on the same reservation, nights paid in cash never share a reservation with awards.
4. **Types together.** Awards of different types may be combined on one reservation where the award type's terms allow several awards on one reservation.

The count is read from the award records of the reservation in the system: the awards whose reservation is that reservation and whose status is applied.

## Count at the limit (hypothetical counts)

| Awards already standing applied to the reservation | Award being applied | Within the limit |
|---|---|---|
| One fewer than the most awards per reservation | One more | Yes: together they reach the most and do not exceed it |
| Exactly the most awards per reservation | One more | No: together they exceed the most |
| None | The first award | Yes |

An award that was on the reservation but has since been released or forfeited no longer stands applied to it and is not counted.

## Night allocation (hypothetical reservation)

A hypothetical five-night Reward Night Rate reservation, arriving on a Thursday, on which the member uses two awards under terms that apply awards to the earliest nights:

- the first award pays Thursday night, the earliest night not yet paid by an award;
- the second award pays Friday night, which is then the earliest night not yet paid by an award;
- Saturday, Sunday and Monday nights are paid with points.
